headline: French Polynesia: +1.1% growth in 2024
sections: French Polynesia is a $6.3 billion economy (2024), the world's 169th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +1.1% in 2024, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Manufacturing accounts for 4.7% of GDP (2020).
Unemployment stood at 11.7% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 36.6% (2025).
